HOWEVER it is downgraded from a clean '5' because: (i) divergence prong (2) [FN under-supplies P5/P6, is mere relabeling] is a card-supplied, contestable physics judgment about a named mechanism that drifts toward the structure/content boundary and is partly an E.4-rubric artifact rather than forced by the endpoints; (ii) the N_gen=3 selection predicate imports the 'anomaly cancellation permits other counts' physics premise to shape the hole, a mild fit-to-physics that should be flagged as an external premise; (iii) the E019 shared-layer clustering leans on conventional UV-completion reasoning the discipline says to avoid.
